cues.en: In this video, I'm going to discuss the natural exponent and the logarithm, I'll show you a little bit about what these functions look like.

cues.en: And then in the exercise, you will get to use Python as a tool to help you visualize the fact that these two functions, a natural exponent and the logarithm, are inverses of each other.
cues.zh: 練習會用 Python 幫助視覺化，說明自然指數和對數互為反函數。

cues.en: So the natural exponent or E to the X and the natural logarithm or the log of X are nonlinear functions that have this kind of curved shape like this.
cues.zh: 自然指數 e 的 x 次方，以及自然對數 log(x)，都是像這樣彎曲的非線性函數。

cues.en: So if we look at the function Y equals E to the X, then for various ranges of X, E to the X gets arbitrarily

cues.en: close to zero.
cues.zh: 接近 0。

cues.en: So it never gets to be zero, but it becomes really, really, really close to zero as X goes to minus infinity.
cues.zh: 不會真的到 0，但當 x 趨近負無限大，會非常非常接近 0。

cues.en: And then up here Y, so the function E to the X goes up to plus infinity as X gets larger.
cues.zh: 往這邊，x 越大，y，也就是 e 的 x 次方，趨近正無限大。

cues.en: So that's the function E to the X.
cues.zh: 這就是 e 的 x 次方。

cues.en: And now if we look at the log of X, the natural logarithm of X, you can see it also has kind of a similar shape in the sense that it's bent and it looks like it's going to infinity in both directions.
cues.zh: 再看 log(x)，也就是自然對數，形狀有點像，都是彎曲的，看起來往兩個方向趨近無限。

cues.en: However, in this case, the log of X goes down to minus infinity on the Y axis.
cues.zh: 不過這裡，log(x) 沿 y 軸往下，趨近負無限大。

cues.en: You can see these numbers are getting smaller as X goes towards zero.
cues.zh: x 趨近 0 時，這些數字越來越小。

cues.en: And now the log of X is not defined for any negative numbers.
cues.zh: log(x) 對負數沒有定義。

cues.en: So if you would try to take the log of a negative number, you would end up getting a complex number.
cues.zh: 若試著取負數的對數，會得到複數。

cues.en: And that's why on this graph here, you only see positive values of X and going up this way, the logarithm basically continues to grow up to infinity here.
cues.zh: 所以圖上只顯示正的 x。往這邊，對數會持續增加，趨近無限大。

cues.en: As X gets arbitrarily large, however, it grows to infinity slower and slower and slower, unlike E to the X, which grows to infinity faster and faster.
cues.zh: x 可以任意大，但它趨近無限大的速度越來越慢；e 的 x 次方則越來越快。
